headline: Nifco Faces Major Disruption After Ransomware Paralyzes Plant Operations
body: Nifco Inc., a leader in automotive parts manufacturing, is grappling with a serious ransomware attack that has immobilized its critical production and logistics systems. The incident forced a complete standstill at several facilities, as technicians work with external cybersecurity experts to regain control of the impacted networks. While Nifco engages with top-notch specialists to remediate the attack, the company has not yet disclosed when it expects operations to resume fully. The disruption underscores the growing vulnerability of industrial sectors to cyber threats.
